reference.title: Scenario 10 — 2-column table in API Reference Section

section.p: Consider a 2-column table inside a section that belongs to an API reference section — for example, a parameter details or API attribute list.

table.title: Reference topic with API two-column table

row.entry: [Heading 2]: API Parameters (reference topic) │ Parameter │ Description │ │ timeout │ Request timeout (sec) │ │ retry_count │ Number of retry attempts│ │ log_level │ Logging verbosity │

entry.codeblock: <reference id="api_parameters"> <title>API Parameters</title> <refbody> <properties> <prophead> <proptypehd>Parameter</proptypehd> <propvaluehd>Description</propvaluehd> </prophead> <property> <proptype>timeout</proptype> <propvalue>Request timeout in seconds</propvalue> </property> <property> <proptype>retry_count</proptype> <propvalue>Number of retry attempts</propvalue> </property> <property> <proptype>log_level</proptype> <propvalue>Logging verbosity</propvalue> </property> </properties> </refbody> </reference>

section.p: Result:The converter recognises API reference section and maps the parameter-description data to <properties>. For general comparison tables, status tables, or multi-column reference data, the converter maps to <simpletable> or CALS <table> instead.
